messages:
olivia: Quick async check — planning a staggered mini-rollout for SDK v2.4 (hosted + dedicated samples). Need to lock owners for: sample apps, quickstarts, changelog entries, and QA signoff. Cutoff for content = EOD Tues PT. Who's on what?

raj: I can take python sample app updates. will finish local smoke tests by Wed AM PT. any new env var names i should watch for?

kevin: No new env vars. There's a small param rename in the client `request.timeout_ms` -> `request.timeout` but we keep alias for one release. i'll add a deprecation note. @olivia what timezone exactly for EOD?

olivia: EOD = 2026-03-17 23:59 PT (so that folks in EU get Wed morning). If you miss cutoff, your changelog item gets deferred to the next mini-rollout.

jenny: I can own the docs snippets + quickstart updates. i'll push a PR to `docs/quickstarts/sdk-v2` and tag reviewers @sam and @kevin. ETA Tue evening.

sam: I'll review docs + sample app code. Heads up — the CI flake on macOS runner is still intermittent; if you see `npm run build` fail, just re-run the job.

olivia: Thanks. For QA: we need regression checks for streaming + tokenization differences after the client change. @raj can your smoke tests include a streaming scenario?

raj: yep — I'll add a short streaming smoke test and a tokenization sanity assert. will include instructions for QA to reproduce locally.

kevin: Changelog plan: I'll add an entry under "SDK" with the rename + alias note, and a short "sample apps updated" blurb. jenny — once your PRs are open, tag `#changelog-drafts`.

jenny: will do. also planning one-line examples for the new function signatures.

olivia: Ownership summary (copy/paste for clarity):
- python samples: raj
- quickstarts & snippets: jenny
- changelog + release note: kevin
- docs + reviewer: sam
- QA smoke tests: raj + sam

please reply with :thumbsup: if this matches your expectation or correct me.

sam: :thumbsup: small ask — can we gate the rollout by a canary flag? if we see 5% error increase we rollback automatically.

kevin: That makes sense. We have a `devex.canary` toggle in the release config. i'll wire the automatic rollback threshold to 5% error + 2x latency.

deploy-bot: [info] Scheduled mini-rollout window: 2026-03-18 02:00-03:00 UTC. Canary enabled (5%). Will post status updates in this thread during rollout.

olivia: Perfect. Final notes: 1) put changelog drafts in `#changelog-drafts` 2) open sample-app PRs early so reviewers have time, 3) if docs need screenshots, ping design early.

kevin: I'll post the changelog PR before cutoff and add a short checklist in the PR description.

raj: starting work now. i'll ping here when python sample PR is ready for review.

jenny: prepping docs PR. ETA Tue 20:00 PT.

olivia: thanks team — appreciate the quick alignment. we'll call this synced unless someone objects in the next 2 hours.

docs-bot: Reminder: please attach screenshots using the `!screenshots` macro to include optimized images in the docs build.

raj: noted, thanks.

kevin: :rocket:
